text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

words.gloss_range: emphatic accusative-governing particle opening a confirmed report
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the whole ayah into confirmed testimony rather than another prohibition. Its governance gathers the voice-lowerers, their identification, and the reward into one asserted proposition, while its position after warning marks the discourse shift from direct command to certified status.

topics.headline: emphatic particle governs the whole reward assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the praise and reward are not loose description but one emphatically governed proposition.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes the following relative group the governed subject and the later demonstrative predicate part of the same assertion.

topics.headline: warning shifts into certified testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah is no longer issuing a prohibition but declaring the status of those who embodied the warning.
topics.reason: The emphatic report follows the prior warning register and recasts obedience as third-person testimony.

topics.headline: opening launches staged recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah unfold in stages: description, identification, then consequence.
topics.reason: The predicate is delayed until the demonstrative pivot, making the opening particle carry an anticipatory span.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun defining a praised group by its action
words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the subject a behavior-defined class. The reader must first process the group's ongoing voice-lowering before hearing its status, and the later repetition of the same relative form lets human discipline and divine testing mirror each other.

topics.headline: relative subject is defined by action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that praise is restricted to the group characterized by the following action, not spread generically across all hearers.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the governed subject of the emphatic particle and is completed by its following verb.

topics.headline: identity and behavior stay fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is not named first and described later; their identity is built out of the discipline itself.
topics.reason: The relative construction makes the action clause constitutive for the subject before predication arrives.

topics.headline: double relative mirrors human and divine action
topics.reader_payoff: The repeated relative form makes the reader pair what they do with what God has done to them.
topics.reason: The second relative pronoun later reuses the same form for the divine-testing clause, keeping one referent while changing predicate content.

words.gloss_range: ongoing collective lowering, lessening, and restraint of communicative output
words.root_gloss_range: root field of lowering, diminishing, and restraining; here narrowed by the voice object to habitual speech restraint
words.prose: {{ar:يَغُضُّونَ}} ({{tr:yaghuḍḍūna}}) presents lowering as a collective habit, not a single polite moment. The root {{ar:غ ض ض}} ({{tr:gh-d-d}}) supplies the concrete pressure of reduction, the object narrows it to voice-control, and the rare gaze-and-voice distribution makes this the auditory member of a wider sensory-restraint pattern. Its morphology keeps the action bound to the relative group, the doubled sound thickens the felt restraint, and conscious self-monitoring answers the previous danger of unperceived excess.

topics.headline: imperfect plural marks settled group practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a continuing communal trait rather than a one-time lowered utterance.
topics.reason: The imperfect 3mp verb attaches to the relative group and distributes the action across them.

topics.headline: lowering root narrows to controlled speech output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees voice-lowering as deliberate modulation of public output, not merely being quiet.
topics.reason: The broader lowering and lessening field survives, but the explicit voice object selects communicative restraint as the local sense.

topics.headline: voice restraint echoes gaze restraint in 24:30-31
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same rare restraint root move from gaze discipline in 24:30-31 to voice discipline here.
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence links the root with gaze commands in 24:30-31 and the present voice scene, without making the gaze sense govern this local object.

topics.headline: geminate sound iconically compresses output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the thick doubled consonant matching the act of holding sound back.
topics.reason: The geminate root and phonetic observations add an audible restraint effect without changing the lexical sense.

topics.headline: rare root marks auditory restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not ordinary vocabulary for speaking softly but a marked root used in a small restraint set.
topics.reason: The supplied corpus distribution makes the local combination with voice distinctive while leaving the local parse unchanged.

topics.headline: conscious restraint answers prior unperceived failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees self-monitoring replace the prior danger of unnoticed excess.
topics.reason: The boundary row contrasts deliberate lowering with the prior warning about loss without perception.

topics.headline: verb ending binds action to the relative group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the action held tightly inside the described group rather than introduced as a separate clause with a new actor.
topics.reason: The verb morphology supplies the plural subject while the relative pronoun fixes its referent.

words.gloss_range: their plural voices as the direct object and affected public output
words.root_gloss_range: sound, voice, and public declaration; here narrowed to the group's own audible expression
words.prose: {{ar:أَصْوَاتَهُمْ}} ({{tr:aṣwātahum}}) names the group's own voices as the object being lowered. The plural suffix makes restraint self-regulating and communal, while the root {{ar:ص و ت}} ({{tr:ṣ-w-t}}) keeps both physical sound and public assertion in view; the same suffix later on hearts ties outer output to inner disposition. Across 49:2 and 49:3, the voice field moves from addressed warning to praised third-person description.

topics.headline: their own voices receive the lowering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees restraint enacted on the group's own expression, not imposed on someone else.
topics.reason: The noun is the accusative object of the lowering verb and carries the possessive suffix referring to the same group.

topics.headline: broken plural makes discipline communal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many individual voices gathered under one shared discipline.
topics.reason: The broken plural plus possessive suffix distributes the affected field across the group.

topics.headline: voice includes acoustic sound and public assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that lowering voice also restrains communicative assertion in the messenger's presence.
topics.reason: The broader voice and declaration field survives, while the local direct object keeps the sense anchored in audible output.

topics.headline: outer voices pair with inner hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same group own both the exterior sound and the interior faculty God tested.
topics.reason: The repeated possessive suffix on voices and hearts creates a local outer-inner mapping.

topics.headline: voice root moves from warning to praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same voice field move from addressed danger in 49:2 to third-person commendation in 49:3.
topics.reason: The adjacent ayahs repeat the voice root while changing person and evaluative frame from prohibition to praise.

words.gloss_range: locative adverb of presence and proximity governing the following genitive phrase
words.root_gloss_range: near, with, in the presence or domain of; here narrowed to presence before the messenger with authority-domain overtones
words.prose: {{ar:عِنْدَ}} ({{tr:ʿinda}}) frames the lowering as conduct in presence, not motion toward a destination. As a locative annexed to the following title, the root {{ar:ع ن د}} ({{tr:ʿ-n-d}}) allows both physical nearness and authority-domain to remain visible, so the voices are disciplined within the messenger's presence. The phrase can locate the act or characterize the lowered voices, its sound binds into the genitive phrase, and the surah later shifts measure-language to God in 49:13.

topics.headline: locative governs by annexation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees presence framed through a locative construct, not a bare preposition.
topics.reason: The local grammar treats the word as an adverbial place expression governing the following genitive complement.

topics.headline: presence includes authority-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene is about comportment inside the messenger's presence-domain, not simply reduced volume nearby.
topics.reason: The root range includes proximity and jurisdiction, while local syntax narrows it to the location of the voice-lowering scene.

topics.headline: locative may qualify act or voices
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the phrase can locate either the lowering act or the voices being lowered, without changing the main command frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the locative phrase with the lowering frame while allowing scope over the act or affected voices.

topics.headline: proximity to messenger is a recognized relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees local presence near the messenger as one stage before the surah later measures rank with God in 49:13.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence and surah-local echo make proximity language meaningful without overriding the local locative function.

topics.headline: sound binds the locative phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the proximity marker merge into its following genitive phrase as one unit.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supports auditory cohesion of the phrase, not a separate lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: singular construct messenger-title naming the authorized sent figure
words.root_gloss_range: sending, release, and transmitted mission; here narrowed to the specific messenger as delegated divine channel
words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولِ}} ({{tr:rasūli}}) is not merely a personal label. Its construct form and the root {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) present the figure as the one sent, a specific authorized channel whose authority is completed by the following divine name; the title also shifts the prior focus from prophetic voice to messenger-presence. Within the surah opening, this continues the authority thread from 49:1 into immediate presence.

topics.headline: singular construct specifies one authorized channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a specific messenger identified through relation to God, not a generic envoy.
topics.reason: The construct head gains definiteness from its genitive complement and remains singular.

topics.headline: messenger title foregrounds sent authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lowered voices answer delegated transmission, not only interpersonal courtesy.
topics.reason: The root's sending and transmission field survives in the role noun, while the local construct specifies the present messenger.

topics.headline: person is viewed through role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same historical person under the function of authorized messengerhood.
topics.reason: The broader person-versus-function range is narrowed locally to the singular messenger of God.

topics.headline: messenger-root threads the opening of the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the opening movement from before God and messenger in 49:1 to presence with the messenger in 49:3.
topics.reason: The supplied surah-local references show the messenger title participating in a repeated authority thread.

topics.headline: construct chain routes authority to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that voice etiquette honors a delegated divine authority chain.
topics.reason: The messenger noun is bound to the divine name, making the authority derivative rather than self-standing.

topics.headline: prophet title gives way to messenger title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a title shift from acoustic standard in 49:2 to delegated presence in 49:3.
topics.reason: The adjacent title change reframes the same referent from voice-measure to messenger-presence.

words.gloss_range: genitive proper divine name completing the messenger construct
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name with debated derivational background; here fixed as the singular divine source of the messenger's authority
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) completes the construct chain and makes the messenger's authority sourced in the singular divine name. The root {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) background does not loosen the proper-name force here; the genitive use also prepares the later shift to God as direct nominative agent.

topics.headline: proper name sources messenger authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the messenger's authority is not merely social recognition but is sourced in God.
topics.reason: The proper divine name stands as the genitive complement completing the construct phrase.

topics.headline: derivational dispute stays subordinate to proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register worship and ultimate-reference background without turning the name into a generic noun.
topics.reason: The disputed root background may color the name, but the local form is a proper noun in a construct chain.

topics.headline: first divine name anticipates agentive second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same divine name move from genitive source of authority to nominative tester of hearts.
topics.reason: The repeated name changes case role within the ayah, tracking movement from mediated authority to direct divine action.

words.gloss_range: far plural demonstrative functioning as an identificatory pivot
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) pivots the ayah from the outward description to the divine explanation. Its far demonstrative form re-identifies the same group with elevated distinctness, and its extended written and recitational weight makes the midpoint feel like a hinge rather than a flat continuation.

topics.headline: demonstrative re-identifies the voice-lowerers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first relative group paused, pointed to, and then re-presented for divine validation.
topics.reason: The demonstrative begins the predicate of the emphatic clause and points back to the described group.

topics.headline: far demonstrative elevates the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices grammatical distance functioning as distinction and elevation in a praise context.
topics.reason: The far demonstrative marks distinction without introducing a new referent.

topics.headline: long demonstrative shape slows the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the midpoint stretch before the ayah moves from human action to divine testing.
topics.reason: The orthographic and prosodic rows converge with the syntactic position between two relative clauses.

words.gloss_range: second definite relative pronoun re-identifying the same group by divine action
words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) repeats the relative form so the same people are now defined by what God has done to their hearts. The structure pairs visible restraint with divine validation, keeping the referent stable while shifting from human practice to God's testing.

topics.headline: second relative makes divine action definitional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the praised group's status grounded in God's act, not only in outward etiquette.
topics.reason: The second definite relative clause further specifies the demonstrative and identifies the same group by divine testing.

topics.headline: two relatives create action-to-validation architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a movement from what they do outwardly to what God has validated inwardly.
topics.reason: The repeated relative form joins the two beats while changing the predicate content.

words.gloss_range: completed divine testing, proving, and refining of hearts
words.root_gloss_range: testing, proving, stretching, and refining by pressure; here narrowed to God's completed inward testing of hearts for taqwā
words.prose: {{ar:ٱمْتَحَنَ}} ({{tr:imtaḥana}}) reports a completed divine certification, not a condition still waiting to happen, and the following explicit agent makes the tester surface-prominent. The root {{ar:م ح ن}} ({{tr:m-ḥ-n}}) carries testing as refining pressure, even smelting-like purification, while the Form VIII shape intensifies the inward examination of hearts. Its rare form and dense sound mark the phrase, and the contrast with human testing in 60:10 keeps this local act divine, internal, and completed.

topics.headline: perfect aspect presents testing as completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees voice-lowering as evidence of an already completed divine process, not a mere entry requirement.
topics.reason: The perfect verb reports the testing as completed in the predicate clause.

topics.headline: explicit agent gives God surface prominence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the tester named on the surface instead of inferred from the verb ending.
topics.reason: The following nominative divine name is explicit even though the verb could carry a hidden subject.

topics.headline: testing carries refining and softening pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees God's test as transformative refinement of the heart, not bare inspection.
topics.reason: The supplied root images of proving, stretching, and smelting survive as image pressure, while local grammar selects divine testing of hearts.

topics.headline: Form VIII suits inward heart-testing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the derived form adding depth and intensity to the examination.
topics.reason: The local form is Form VIII, fitting an inward object whose quality is proved under pressure.

topics.headline: divine heart-testing contrasts with human testing in 60:10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes God's completed testing of hearts here from human commanded testing of persons in 60:10.
topics.reason: The supplied recurrence links the rare root to 60:10 while keeping this local form divine, internal, and completed.

topics.headline: rare root, form, and aspect converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rarity, dense sound, Form VIII, and perfect aspect all make the heart-testing expression marked.
topics.reason: The markedness rows converge on the same local payoff without creating a different lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine name as explicit subject of the testing verb
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name; here fixed as the direct agent acting on hearts
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) makes God the explicit nominative agent of the testing. The root {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) background remains subordinate to the proper name, while the case shift from the earlier genitive divine name moves the ayah from sourced messenger authority to direct divine action.

topics.headline: God is named as direct tester
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees heart-testing as God's direct act, not social assessment inferred from behavior.
topics.reason: The divine name is overtly nominative after a verb that could otherwise encode its subject.

topics.headline: repeated divine name shifts from source to actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same name progress from source of messenger authority to actor upon hearts.
topics.reason: The earlier genitive and this nominative form create a grammatical progression within the ayah.

words.gloss_range: their plural hearts as the direct object of divine testing
words.root_gloss_range: heart, core, turning, and reversal; here narrowed to the inner faculty tested for stable orientation
words.prose: {{ar:قُلُوبَهُمْ}} ({{tr:qulūbahum}}) shifts the tested object from public sound to the inner faculty. The suffix keeps these hearts tied to the same voice-lowerers, while root {{ar:ق ل ب}} ({{tr:q-l-b}}) makes the tested faculty one known for turning; the ayah proves inner stability through outward restraint. The plural distributes that inward testing across the group, and this positive heart-action contrasts with sealing in 2:7 while joining later heart scenes in 49:7 and 49:14.

topics.headline: hearts are the object of divine testing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees God testing the inner faculty of the same people whose voices were lowered.
topics.reason: The noun is the accusative object of the testing verb and carries the same group suffix.

topics.headline: heart root carries turning pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God tests the faculty known for turning, so the payoff is proved stability of orientation.
topics.reason: The turning family supplies image pressure, but the local surface remains the plural noun for hearts.

topics.headline: plural suffix distributes inner testing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees each member's inner center affected while the group identity remains shared.
topics.reason: The concrete plural plus suffix presents hearts as distributed inner centers belonging to the praised group.

topics.headline: tested hearts contrast with other divine heart actions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this heart-action as positive validation within a wider Quranic and surah-local heart field, contrasting with sealing in 2:7 and later heart scenes in 49:7 and 49:14.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows locate this tested-heart phrase among other divine actions on hearts without changing the local positive function.

topics.headline: same suffix binds voices and hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the same group suffix bind exterior voice and interior heart.
topics.reason: The repeated suffix on the voice object and heart object creates a structural and acoustic pair.

words.gloss_range: preposition routing divine testing toward purpose, result, or suitability
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the small hinge that routes tested hearts toward taqwā. It governs the following noun and keeps purpose, result, and suitability in play, so the testing clause does not simply inspect hearts; it orients them toward the quality that opens into reward.

topics.headline: preposition governs the taqwā relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees taqwā mediated by the preposition rather than standing as a direct object of testing.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the genitive noun and attaches the phrase to the testing verb.

topics.headline: lām keeps aim, result, and suitability live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the testing is oriented toward taqwā as aim, outcome, or fitness, not merely followed by a pious label.
topics.reason: The particle's range is preserved, while local syntax limits it to the relation between divine testing and taqwā.

topics.headline: fused lām phrase pivots into reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the phrase as the hinge from tested hearts into the reward clause.
topics.reason: The proclitic fusion and clause position bind the relation tightly to the following concept and to the ayah's movement.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun naming the established quality of protective God-consciousness
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, shielding, and self-protection; here narrowed to the tested inner quality for which hearts are prepared
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-taqwā}}) is definite, so the testing is for a known standard rather than vague goodness. The root {{ar:و ق ي}} ({{tr:w-q-y}}) keeps the shield and self-guarding image active, while the verbal-noun form makes this a validated quality of hearts rather than a fresh command. The same root runs through 49:10, 49:12, and 49:13, and here it hinges tested hearts into the gifts that follow.

topics.headline: definite taqwā names an established standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the hearts tested for the recognized standard of taqwā, not for unspecified goodness.
topics.reason: The definite article and noun form make the quality already established in the discourse.

topics.headline: taqwā carries shielding and self-guarding force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices taqwā as active protective awareness, not mere abstract piety or fear.
topics.reason: The guarding and shielding root family survives as image pressure, while local grammar selects the verbal noun as the tested quality.

topics.headline: verbal noun differs from command forms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees taqwā here as a quality validated in hearts, whereas the surah elsewhere issues taqwā commands.
topics.reason: The maṣdar form and supplied surah-local contrast distinguish tested disposition from imperative demand.

topics.headline: w-q-y thread runs through Surah 49
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks taqwā from tested hearts in 49:3 to command forms in 49:10 and 49:12 and comparative nobility in 49:13.
topics.reason: The supplied surah-local occurrences show the same root moving between status, command, and evaluation.

topics.headline: taqwā bridges tested hearts and gifts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees taqwā as the pivot between inward testing and the outwardly assigned gifts.
topics.reason: The phrase closes the testing clause and immediately precedes the reward clause.

words.gloss_range: fronted preposition of possession, benefit, and assignment in the reward clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) starts the reward clause by assigning benefit before the gifts are named. Its fronted predicate position makes the recipients the first assertion, and its fusion with the pronoun turns possession, benefit, and entitlement into a compact landing point for forgiveness and reward.

topics.headline: fronted beneficiary precedes the gifts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees assignment to the group before the gifts themselves unfold.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is the fronted predicate of the nominal reward clause.

topics.headline: benefit and possession senses remain local
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rewards as both for them and assigned to them as a stable predication.
topics.reason: The broader lām functions are narrowed by the reward clause to benefit, possession, and assignment.

topics.headline: preposition fuses to pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees beneficiary assignment compressed into one bound unit before the reward nouns appear.
topics.reason: The written form binds the preposition directly to the pronoun.

words.gloss_range: third-person plural pronoun governed by the fronted lām and resuming the praised group
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) compresses the whole previously described group into the beneficiary pronoun. Grammatically they are not performing a new act here; the clause assigns reward to them, and the shift from addressed danger to third-person reward invites the hearers to become that praised class.

topics.headline: pronoun is beneficiary complement, not new subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the group receiving assigned reward rather than acting again.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the preceding preposition inside the fronted predicate.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes the full praised chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees two relative clauses and the demonstrative reduced to one beneficiary marker.
topics.reason: The pronoun points back to the already established voice-lowering and divinely tested group.

topics.headline: addressed warning becomes third-person reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from second-person risk to a third-person praised class that hearers may join.
topics.reason: The boundary row tracks the shift from addressed warning forms to praise forms.

words.gloss_range: indefinite delayed verbal-noun gift of forgiveness and protective covering
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, forgiving, and protective covering; here narrowed to granted forgiveness after taqwā
words.prose: {{ar:مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:maghfiratun}}) is disclosed after the beneficiaries have already been named. The root {{ar:غ ف ر}} ({{tr:gh-f-r}}) keeps forgiveness concrete as protective covering, fitting the prior guarding field, and its indefinite delayed noun form leaves the covering unmeasured before the reward half is added. Its mīm-prefixed verbal noun form names a granted act or state, forgiveness comes before recompense, and the motif answers the prior threat while recurring in 49:5 and 49:14.

topics.headline: delayed indefinite forgiveness follows assigned beneficiaries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause first land on the recipients and then open an unmeasured gift of forgiveness.
topics.reason: The noun is a delayed nominative subject after the fronted predicate and is indefinite with tanwīn.

topics.headline: forgiveness is protective covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness as covering and protection that answers the prior self-guarding field.
topics.reason: The covering-root image survives as payoff, while the local noun selects forgiveness as the granted outcome.

topics.headline: mīm-prefixed verbal noun names a granted act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness as a granted event or state, not merely an adjective describing God.
topics.reason: The form is a mīm-prefixed verbal noun in the reward clause.

topics.headline: forgiveness and recompense form a double outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness and reward as coordinated gifts sharing the same assignment to the group.
topics.reason: The two nominative indefinites are coordinated under the fronted predicate and are a recognized local pairing.

topics.headline: covering precedes recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward sequence move from covering fault to positive recompense.
topics.reason: The noun for forgiveness comes before the noun for recompense in the coordinated pair.

topics.headline: forgiveness recurs as closure motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 49:3 answer the prior threat of voided deeds with assigned covering and recompense, while forgiveness also recurs in 49:5 and 49:14.
topics.reason: The boundary and surah-local rows make forgiveness part of an opening-section outcome pattern.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding the second reward noun to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the reward phrase from collapsing into a single appositional idea. It makes forgiveness and reward cumulative, binds the second gift directly to the first, and lets the recited transition audibly stitch the two gifts together under one beneficiary assignment.

topics.headline: conjunction makes the gifts cumulative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness and reward as two coordinated gifts rather than alternative or collapsed outcomes.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two reward nouns under the same fronted predicate.

topics.headline: attached conjunction starts no new clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second reward noun joined immediately, not launched as an unrelated clause.
topics.reason: The conjunction is attached directly to the second noun.

topics.headline: sound transition binds the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the nasal ending flow into the conjunction, making the two gifts cohere acoustically.
topics.reason: The prosodic row supports auditory binding of the reward pair.

words.gloss_range: indefinite coordinated recompense, wage-like reward, and nominal entitlement
words.root_gloss_range: wage, hire, compensation, and recompense; here narrowed to divine reward assigned for praised restraint
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرٌ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}) adds positive recompense after forgiveness while sharing the same fronted assignment to the group. The root {{ar:أ ج ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-j-r}}) keeps a wage-and-compensation field visible, so the reward is attached to disciplined conduct rather than vague favor, and its indefiniteness lets the following greatness magnify an unmeasured recompense. The phrase belongs to a wider great-reward promise register, with parallels such as 3:172, 5:9, 33:35, and 48:29, and it begins the terminal expansion that the final adjective seals.

topics.headline: reward shares the same fronted assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reward assigned to the same group under the same clause, not as a separate sentence.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated with the delayed forgiveness noun under the fronted predicate.

topics.headline: agreement attaches greatness to recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the adjective magnify the reward noun specifically, not the whole preceding phrase.
topics.reason: The noun and adjective agree as indefinite nominatives.

topics.headline: indefinite reward remains unmeasured
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward left open in measure before greatness expands it.
topics.reason: The indefinite form with tanwīn withholds quantification and is then qualified by the adjective.

topics.headline: reward carries wage-like recompense force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices compensation attached to the praised discipline, not only an unspecified gift.
topics.reason: The wage and compensation field survives as lexical payoff, while the local clause makes it divine reward.

topics.headline: maṣdar form stabilizes recompense as noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees recompense predicated as a stable nominal entitlement alongside forgiveness.
topics.reason: The verbal noun form makes recompense a noun in the possession clause.

topics.headline: great-reward formula links local restraint to promise register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears local voice-restraint placed in a wider promise formula also seen at 3:172, 5:9, 33:35, and 48:29.
topics.reason: The supplied formulaic pairing links this local reward phrase to recurring promise language.

topics.headline: reward begins terminal expansion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah land by expanding from recipients to forgiveness, reward, and finally greatness.
topics.reason: The noun begins the final reward expansion that the adjective seals.

words.gloss_range: indefinite qualitative adjective assigning great, weighty magnitude to reward
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, magnitude, valuation, and structural solidity; here narrowed to the reward's substantial greatness
words.prose: {{ar:عَظِيمٌ}} ({{tr:ʿaẓīmun}}) seals the ayah by fixing greatness to the reward. The root {{ar:ع ظ م}} ({{tr:ʿ-ẓ-m}}) makes that greatness weighty and substantial, not decorative, while the qualitative form gives the reward durable magnitude and the indefinite agreement keeps it unbounded. The recurrent reward pairing, final tanwīn cadence, and ending reversal all converge: lowered voices lead to magnified recompense.

topics.headline: agreement fixes greatness to reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees greatness modify the recompense noun specifically.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the reward noun as an indefinite nominative.

topics.headline: indefinite adjective keeps magnitude open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees greatness qualify the reward without limiting it to a fixed measure.
topics.reason: The adjective matches the indefinite reward noun, leaving the gift expansive.

topics.headline: greatness carries weight and valuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the adjective as a valuation of weighty, substantial recompense, not a generic flourish.
topics.reason: The root images of magnitude, valuation, and solidity survive as pressure, while local grammar applies them to reward.

topics.headline: qualitative pattern gives durable magnitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees greatness presented as an inherent quality of the reward.
topics.reason: The faʿīl qualitative adjective presents greatness as a stable attribute.

topics.headline: recurrent pairing intensifies recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a familiar major-recompense pairing rather than an isolated adjective.
topics.reason: The supplied root-pair data makes the adjective part of a recurrent reward collocation.

topics.headline: closing greatness answers opening lowering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's scale reverse: self-diminished speech leads to magnified reward.
topics.reason: The final adjective stands opposite the opening lowering action and closes the ayah on magnitude.

topics.headline: tanwīn cadence completes the reward ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated indefinite endings bind forgiveness, reward, and greatness into one expansive close.
topics.reason: The closing cadence rows join acoustic tanwīn, semantic magnitude, and terminal position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3-4 deliberately reduce audible output, while words 10-13 connect an assayed inward faculty to protective caution.
baseline_models.mechanism: A diminished outer signal becomes a visible readout of an inward core that has undergone trial: proximity to the Messenger turns acoustic scale into a moral diagnostic rather than a bare rule of manners.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate lessening supplies the observable operation of self-restraint.
Audible voicing identifies what is being materially regulated.
Trial that discloses an inner state makes the quiet act diagnostic of the heart.
The inward faculty is the actual site being disclosed by the outward restraint.
Self-placement within caution gives the assay its protective orientation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah praises polite low volume near the Messenger.
changed_reading.after: The lowered voice is an embodied test-result: controlled sound exteriorizes a heart formed for protective caution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object in word 4 can carry public repute as well as sound, and the sequence ends with greatness and honor language in word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lessening one's voice can include lowering one's public signal and claim to standing in the Messenger's presence. The result is an inversion: relinquished self-renown is answered by a great return whose magnitude is not self-advertised.

activation_trace.role: Lessening turns public self-projection into something intentionally reduced.
Public repute expands voice from decibels to socially circulating prominence.
Proximity supplies the relational arena in which competing prominence is surrendered.
The bearer of a message supplies the authoritative center against which self-renown recedes.
Social honor lets the great return answer the standing that the speaker declined to perform.

changed_reading.before: They lower only the loudness of their speech.
changed_reading.after: They also lower the social amplitude of the self, refusing to make personal repute rival the Messenger's message.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 4 has a listening-response branch, word 6 bears message and messenger, and words 10-12 refine the inward core.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reducing one's own output reallocates the acoustic channel to reception. The assayed heart is not merely silent; it is purified into a listener able to let message-bearing speech arrive at a deliberate pace.

activation_trace.role: Listening or answering a voice turns reduced output into active reception.
Message-bearing speech is what the cleared channel is meant to receive.
Gentle deliberation gives reception a non-hurried tempo.
Refining after trial makes receptive silence a formed capacity, not emptiness.
The pure inner core is the destination of the received message.

changed_reading.before: Lowering is suppression of speech.
changed_reading.after: Lowering is channel allocation: less self-voicing creates room for message, comprehension, and inward reception.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root sequence moves through lessening, stripping/refinement, core, guarding, protective covering, and recompense.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah can be imaged as controlled uncovering and re-covering. Self-output is reduced; accretions are stripped from the core; the exposed core is fitted for a barrier; forgiveness then covers protectively, and recompense supplies return. Covering at the end is protection after disclosure, not concealment from assay.

activation_trace.role: Reduction initiates the material sequence by taking excess away.
Stripping a filled or covered surface supplies exposure of what had been hidden.
A pure core is what the stripping operation reaches.
A guarding barrier refits the disclosed core with purposeful protection.
Protective covering closes the sequence without undoing the prior disclosure.
Beneficial return makes the completed transformation consequential.

changed_reading.before: A test is followed independently by forgiveness and reward.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a single transformation: subtract excess, expose and purify the core, guard it, then cover it protectively and return benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding context converts acoustic restraint into yielded initiative. One does not place one's speech, judgment, or timing ahead of message-bearing authority; reduced self-voicing permits hearing to become comprehension and compliance.

activation_trace.role: Lessening anchors the revision in the focus act of holding output back.
Listening makes the surrendered acoustic space function as reception.
Forward precedence supplies the initiative that the restrained speaker declines to seize.
The before-the-hands relation locates premature initiative in front of the rightful source.
Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance supplies the positive purpose of not speaking first.

structural_cues: 49:1 orders non-advancement before God and Messenger and closes with divine hearing immediately before the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advancement, being before, and hearing-as-compliance; I infer that vocal lowering yields epistemic and procedural initiative to the message. The live alternative is a narrower sequence of two independent etiquette rules.

changed_reading.before: The speaker lowers volume after entering the Messenger's presence.
changed_reading.after: The speaker refuses to outrun the message with voice, judgment, or timing, so lowered sound becomes yielded precedence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate contrast constructs a vertical social acoustics: loudness rises, occupies the plane above the prophetic voice, and publicizes itself. The focus's downward modulation refuses that superior plane; otherwise the unseen trajectory is a fall or nullification of purposeful work.

activation_trace.role: Lowering by reduction provides the downward counter-movement.
Repute lets acoustic elevation carry a claim to social prominence.
Literal elevation supplies the vertical motion opposed by the focus.
Superiority of rank turns being acoustically above into a status claim.
Public declaration plus raised voice supplies the expansive opposite of controlled sound.
Falling and collapse give the upward claim its paradoxical downward consequence.
Fine awareness explains why the collapse may occur below the actor's threshold of notice.

structural_cues: 49:2 explicitly opposes raised voices above the prophetic voice to the focus's lowered voices, while linking the former to unnoticed loss of works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elevation, superior rank, publicity, collapse, and subtle awareness; I infer that acoustic height indexes attempted authority. A purely decibel-based prohibition remains possible and coexists with this status geometry.

changed_reading.before: Low volume is respectful courtesy.
changed_reading.after: Low volume is refusal to occupy a superior social plane; apparent acoustic ascent can become an unseen ethical fall.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following scene gives restraint architecture and duration. A raised call attempts to cross an enclosure; reason itself can appear as holding the tongue; patience holds the self until the Messenger crosses outward on his own timing. Lowering therefore preserves a boundary rather than merely softening sound.

activation_trace.role: Holding sound back anchors the threshold mechanism in the focus.
Protective barring lets restraint preserve another person's boundary.
A raised call supplies the force attempting to cross the threshold.
Prevention and enclosure make the chambers an active boundary, not a neutral backdrop.
Restraint of the tongue materializes reason as controlled speech.
Holding the self from agitation extends low voice into patient duration.
Passage outward supplies the authorized boundary crossing for which the callers should wait.

structural_cues: 49:4 places calling behind enclosed rooms after the focus; 49:5 replaces forced access with waiting until the Messenger exits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, enclosure, tongue-restraint, patience, and outward passage; I infer that quietness protects a spatial-temporal threshold until its occupant opens it. The alternative is a local privacy rule without a general threshold mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The command regulates how loudly one speaks nearby.
changed_reading.after: It regulates whether one's voice forcibly crosses another's protected space and timing; rational speech knows how to wait at a boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report scene turns lowered voice into an information-flow throttle. An arriving report may be an obscure signal; it must be clarified before speech or action can strike a people. The assayed heart supplies latency between stimulus and propagation, preventing impulsive disturbance from becoming regret.

activation_trace.role: Reduction anchors the throttle in less outgoing signal.
Audible voicing is the channel whose propagation is slowed.
An inward test provides the filtering stage between hearing and acting.
A transmitted report supplies the incoming informational object.
An obscure, ambiguous signal supplies the report's possible low clarity.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies the required clarification step.

strongest_changes: Acoustic lowering became yielded precedence and receptive channel capacity, not only courtesy.
The heart test became transformative valence-reconditioning and manifestation, not divine information gathering.
Public repute and acoustic height became one status economy that is inverted by caution-based honor near God.
Voice restraint expanded into epistemic throttling, boundary-respect, de-escalation, and protection against speech predation.
Contractual recompense remained live beside an incompatible-looking but coexisting account of guided, gratuitous gift.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported several simultaneous mechanisms because its branches form unusually tight cross-domain chains: lessening to listening, stripping to guarded re-covering, public repute to honor, and tenderness to protection. Context then activated vertical, architectural, informational, social, and gift-economy readings, including non-dominant split-root contrasts without collapsing them into a single interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the reputational, material, and ecological models are intended semantic layers or only productive analogies remains open.
The causal direction remains live: a refined heart may produce lowered voice, while repeated vocal restraint may also train and disclose the heart.
The context may generalize Messenger-specific etiquette into a wider speech ethic, or may only illuminate that unique relation by analogy.
The split-root roar-to-composure activation is structurally licensed by the packet but especially dependent on cautious rendering.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Lowered sound is a refining operation on the core.** غ ض ض B001 ("restraining and lowering by lessening"), م ح ن B002 ("refining and purifying after testing"), and ق ل ب B002 ("essence and pure core") form a material sequence. The ayah supplies lowered voices and tested hearts; I infer that repeated acoustic self-lessening exposes and refines the interior rather than merely displaying etiquette. *Taqwā* reads as a trained core-state.
2. **A nested protective architecture.** و ق ي B001 (protective barrier) and غ ف ر B001 ("protective covering") surround the heart-test, with ع ن د B004 locating conduct in the messenger's presence. The packet supplies proximity, guarding, and covering; I infer that restraint at the vulnerable point of encounter creates an inner barrier answered by an outer cover. Forgiveness is thus structurally continuous with disciplined speech.
3. **Repair after testing.** Exploratorily, ء ج ر B002 ("a break knit crookedly") is activated by later commands to repair relations. The direct *ajr* is recompense (B001), but the packet's repair sequence permits the broken-and-knit image to assign recompense a restorative role. I infer that tested restraint can knit damage without pretending no break occurred. The reward clause can carry a reparative afterimage alongside payment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The repeated repair commands in 49:9-10 made the exploratory ء ج ر B002 image of a knitted break newly visible. More decisively, 49:14-15's distinction between spoken faith and faith entering, settling, and enduring in hearts confirmed that lowered voice in this ayah functions as an interior test rather than surface etiquette.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Lowered speech is an assay that refines the inner faculty.** `غ ض ض:B001` means restraining and lowering by lessening, while `م ح ن:B001` is a test that reveals what is within and `م ح ن:B002` is refining or purifying through that test. The explicit object **قُلُوبَهُمْ** anchors the process in `ق ل ب:B001`, the inward faculty. The sequence from the unseen loss of 49:2 to hearts made receptive in 49:7 supplies the structural arc; I infer that voluntary control of an immediately available voice is the test by which an inward protective disposition becomes visible and refined. The verse reads less as praise of quiet manners than as a diagnostic transformation of the heart.

2. **Nearness intensifies restraint rather than granting familiarity.** `ع ن د:B004` includes physical presence and figurative nearness in rank or judgment. In 49:4 the callers stand behind the chambers yet project their voices inward, while 49:5 commends waiting for the Messenger to come out; those spatial contrasts activate **عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ**. The packet gives proximity, distance, calling, and waiting; I infer that proper nearness is measured by responsiveness to the Messenger’s boundary, not by access or volume. The lowering of voice therefore marks an ethical form of presence.

3. **Protective caution and forgiveness form nested shields.** `و ق ي:B002` places the self in protective moral caution, while `غ ف ر:B001` is a protective covering and `غ ف ر:B002` shields an offender from consequence. The order is heart-refinement **for** protection, followed by forgiveness and recompense (`ء ج ر:B001`). The packet supplies the two protective images but not their direction; I infer that inward restraint is the human guard and forgiveness the answering divine cover. The reward clause consequently reads as preservation of a tested interior, not merely payment for reduced volume.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 49:15 makes the assay legible: truth is not merely claimed but shown through stable trust and costly action. `م ح ن:B001` and `م ح ن:B002` therefore anticipate an evidentiary pattern that the closing ayat complete, with restrained voice as the first outward trace of a revealed and refined heart.

findings.text: Ses kısma, nezaket gösterisi olmaktan öte, kalbin içindekini açığa çıkarıp arıtan bir sınama işlevi görür.
Elçinin yanında bulunmak, sınırları gevşeten bir yakınlık değil; erişim arttıkça özdenetimi yoğunlaştıran etik bir yakınlıktır.
İçteki koruyucu sakınma ile dıştan gelen bağışlayıcı örtü, sınanmış kalbi iki kat koruyan karşılıklı bir yapı kurar.
Ödülün, kırılmış bir yeri eğri de olsa yeniden kaynatan onarım anlamı taşıması, sonraki barış ayetlerinden geriye kurulan fakat fazla dolaylı bir okumadır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protected interior is approached across a boundary whose crossing must be authorized, patient, and inwardly completed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Architectural enclosure becomes a model for reason, piety, pardon, and the difference between an exterior declaration and an admitted interior state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covering as Protection and Pardon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A vulnerable interior is preserved by shielding, avoidance, and a cover that can also conceal fault.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shielding from harm `quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`; placing oneself within protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`; protective covering `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`; covering a fault in pardon `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; atonement that covers a wrong `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; moving aside from danger `quranic:root_000262:B003/m01`; reason as a restraining barrier `quranic:root_000296:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: protection occurs at 49:1, 3, 10, 12, and 13; pardon at 49:3, 5, and 14; covering at 49:7; avoidance at 49:12; the chamber root at 49:4.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Protection is assembled from several compatible operations: a barrier restrains approach, the self moves aside from exposure, and a cover prevents injury or covers an already committed fault. Pardon and atonement extend that cover from prevention to repair. The chamber boundary is thus reframed as an ethical technology protecting both what is within and the person who might otherwise trespass.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Vertical Calibration of Voice and Standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social relation is made audible and spatial through controlled height: voices rise or lower, and persons are elevated by genuine standing rather than self-assertion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Acoustic altitude becomes a diagnostic of social rank, yet the surah reverses the expected ladder by locating durable elevation in restraint and protected character.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Received Standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Standing is elevated by tested quality, prior good, and conferred distinction rather than by the claimant's own lift.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: elevation in rank `quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`; height or loftiness `quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`; superior rank `quranic:root_001188:B002/m01`; granted distinction `quranic:root_001163:B002/m01`; inherent honor `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; greatness `quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`; public honor and inviolability `quranic:root_001029:B010/m01`; prior standing in good `quranic:root_001207:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: elevation and "above" occur at 49:2-3; greatness and reward at 49:3; distinction at 49:8; the name/height root at 49:11, 16, and 18; honor at 49:13; precedence at 49:1.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rank language extends the voice scale into a social hierarchy, but its stable forms are received or recognized: tested quality, prior good, granted distinction, and protected honor. The scale is real, yet persons do not establish their own position merely by speaking from above.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Vertical Calibration of Voice and Standing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social relation is made audible and spatial through controlled height: voices rise or lower, and persons are elevated by genuine standing rather than self-assertion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Acoustic altitude becomes a diagnostic of social rank, yet the surah reverses the expected ladder by locating durable elevation in restraint and protected character.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rival Self-Elevation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A claimant tries to rise by outnumbering, excessive talk, competitive generosity, and self-magnification.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: claiming superiority `quranic:root_001163:B004/m01`; outnumbering and boasting `quranic:root_001286:B002/m01`; excessive talk or claims `quranic:root_001286:B003/m01`; competing to defeat another in generosity `quranic:root_001294:B006/m01`; rivalry for name or standing `quranic:root_000745:B007/m01`; self-magnification and pride `quranic:root_001029:B006/m01`; competition for a prized object `quranic:root_001533:B010/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, and 18.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This is the counter-scene to received standing. Number, speech, gifts, and valued possessions are turned into instruments for climbing over peers. Because each instrument depends on public comparison, the resulting altitude remains performative and unstable.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Right relation consists in taking a governed direction: not moving ahead of the guide, accepting restraint, and returning after deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance is embodied as procession, measured travel, bridle, tether, city, and road geometry, so obedience appears as coordinated motion rather than passive immobility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Deviation, Overreach, and Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A party leaves the line, moves beyond its limit, and must be turned back to the governing course.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: resistance and deviation `quranic:root_001052:B001/m01`; moving aside `quranic:root_001052:B002/m01`; uncontrolled flow running sideways `quranic:root_001052:B003/m01`; departure from the straight line `quranic:root_000991:B006/m01`; injustice as deviation `quranic:root_001224:B002/m01`; overstepping in aggression `quranic:root_000138:B003/m01`; leaving group or obedience `quranic:root_000400:B006/m01`; ripe fruit breaking through its peel `quranic:root_001156:B002/m01`; disobedience `quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`; return `quranic:root_001191:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: resistance occurs at 49:3 and 13; departure at 49:5; breach at 49:6, 7, and 11; disobedience at 49:7 and 11; deviation, aggression, and return at 49:9.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Aggression is represented as path error and boundary breach before it is treated as a fixed identity. Motion runs sideways, fruit breaks its containing peel, and a faction exits obedience. Because the failure is directional, return remains an available restorative operation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Fractured relations are restored by stopping violence, rejoining separated parts, and setting the whole to a just line and measure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social repair takes material form as patching a vessel, draining a wound, setting a bone, hearing a grievance, balancing a load, and weaving kinship tissue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Treating Wound, Relapse, and Fracture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A wound is drained and filled, a broken bone is set, and the repair is guarded against renewed corruption.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a wound filling and healing `quranic:root_001348:B008/m01`; setting a broken bone `quranic:root_000015:B002/m01`; refracturing a bone `quranic:root_001051:B004/m01`; relapse of a wound `quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`; wound swelling toward corruption `quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`; pus collected in a wound `quranic:root_000281:B006/m01`; abscess emerging from the body `quranic:root_000400:B004/m01`; wound reopening and leaving a trace `quranic:root_000289:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: wound invalidation occurs at 49:2; setting at 49:3; abscess/emergence at 49:5; pus/arrival at 49:6; refracture at 49:7; wound corruption/aggression at 49:9; flesh at 49:12; relapse/covering at 49:3, 5, and 14.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The sequence separates initial closure from durable recovery. Pus and swelling must leave the interior, the fracture must be set, and relapse can still undo apparent healing. This materially pressures both reconciliation and the warning that a completed work can be nullified after it seemed secure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The inward person is a material core whose condition is disclosed by testing, adorned by attachment, and cultivated toward growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The heart becomes refined material, adorned interior, protected kernel, and worked field, while covering can either preserve growth or suppress truth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Seed Sheltered in Pith and Sheath
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A living kernel is placed under cover, held in plant pith, and protected by a fruit sheath before emergence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: seed `quranic:root_000286:B001/m01`; palm pith or inner plant core `quranic:root_001248:B003/m01`; generic protective cover `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; burying or covering seed `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; fruit sheath `quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: seed/love occurs at 49:7, 9, and 12; heart/pith at 49:3, 7, and 14; covering at 49:7.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Concealment is productive when it protects a viable interior. Soil, pith, and sheath do not deny the seed; they preserve it through the interval before manifestation. This makes entry into the heart comparable to germination rather than the mere repetition of a public formula.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın kısma, tutma ve eksiltme eksenli çerçevesi kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Bakışı veya sesi alçaltma, bir kaptaki miktarı azaltma ve birinin değerini düşürme gibi kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin farklı nesnelere uygulanmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bakış, ses, kap içeriği ve toplumsal değerle ilgili kullanımlar çekirdeğe bağlıdır; tazelik anlamı bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel kısma ve azaltma çekirdeğini korur; bakış, ses, kınama ve değerle ilgili anlamları yalnız kendi kalıpları içinde belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tutup kısmak, miktarını azaltmak ya da düzeyini aşağı çekmektir. Bakışın ve sesin alçaltılması, kap içeriğinin eksiltilmesi ve birinin değerinin düşürülmesi bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi tutarak veya kısarak miktarını ya da düzeyini azaltmaktır.
Bakışta göz kapaklarını birbirine yaklaştırıp bakışı aşağı indirme, seste ise yüksekliği azaltma biçiminde gerçekleşir.
Su veya bir kap içindeki şey azaltıldığında çekirdek, somut miktarın eksiltilmesine uygulanır.
Birinin değerini düşürme ile bundan doğan aşağılanma ve eksiklik duygusu, azaltma çekirdeğinin toplumsal alandaki kullanımını oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, tutma ve azaltma çekirdeğini bakışın veya sesin alçaltılması, kap içeriğinin eksiltilmesi ve toplumsal değerin düşürülmesi üzerinden birlikte açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın tazelik, körpelik ve canlı görünüm çerçevesi kaynak ifadesini doğrudan karşılar. Yeni beliren hurma tomurcuğu ve onu yeme eylemi bu çekirdeğin özel nesnesi ve ona bağlı eylemidir; dalın genel tanımını yalnız bu örneğe daraltmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Körpelik ve canlı tazelik bu dalın çekirdeğidir; kısma, azaltma ve anatomik bölge anlamları bunun dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel tazelik ve körpelik niteliğini korur; yeni beliren tomurcuk ile onu yeme anlamını yalnız ilgili biçimlere bağlı özel kullanımlar sayar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin henüz taze, körpe ve canlı görünümünü koruyan durumda olmasıdır. Bitkilerin canlılığı, gençliğin tazeliği ve yeni beliren hurma tomurcuğu bu niteliğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, uzun süre beklememiş bir şeydeki tazelik, körpelik ve canlı görünüm niteliğidir.
Nitelik, canlı ve taze bitkiler ile gençliğin diri görünümünü anlatacak biçimde genişler.
Yeni belirmeye başlayan körpe hurma tomurcuğu, tazelik çekirdeğinin özel bir bitkisel gerçekleşmesidir.
Körpe hurma tomurcuğunu yemek, taze nesneye bağlı olarak türetilmiş bir eylem kullanımını oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tazelik ve körpelik çekirdeğinde birleşir; bu niteliği canlı bitkilere, gençliğe ve yeni beliren hurma tomurcuğuna uygular, ayrıca körpe tomurcuğu yeme eylemini kaydeder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi terimi yüzün veya başın ön tarafındaki bir bölge adı olarak doğrular, fakat bölgenin kesin sınırında iki görüş aktarır. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir; tanımın burun sırtı çevresi ile başın ön kısmına bitişik yüz alanını tek ve kesin bir yer gibi birleştirmemesi gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu bir anatomik bölge adıdır; kesin kapsamı iki aktarım arasında değişir ve azaltma ya da tazelik anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bölge adını verir ve kaynakta aktarılan iki yer belirlemesini alternatif sınırlar olarak açıkça korur.

concept_map.definition: Bazı ağızlarda yüzün üst veya ön bölümündeki bir bölgenin adıdır. Bir görüş burun sırtını ve ona komşu yüzü, öteki görüş ise başın ön kısmını ve ona bitişik yüz alanını kapsar.

facets.statement: Sözcük, yüz ile başın ön tarafında yer alan bir anatomik bölgeyi adlandırır.
Bir görüşe göre adlandırılan yer burun sırtı ile onun çevresindeki yüz bölümüdür.
Başka bir görüşe göre adlandırılan yer başın ön kısmı ile ona bitişik yüz bölümüdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın işitilen ses odağı, kaynak ifadesindeki kulağa ulaşan genel ses kavramıyla uyumludur. Şarkı, bağırma, gürültü, yardım çağrısı ve birine seslenme gibi kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin özel ya da yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir; genel sesin kurucu anlamı sayılmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, şiddeti ve kaynağı ne olursa olsun işitilebilir sestir; bağırış, şarkı ve seslenme bunun bağlama bağlı alt kullanımlarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim genel işitilebilir sesi karşılar; şarkı türü, birine seslenme ve çok ya da yüksek ses çıkarma okumaları yalnızca tanıklanan biçim veya söz öbekleriyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kulağın algılayabildiği, insanlardan, hayvanlardan, kuşlardan ya da başka kaynaklardan çıkabilen sestir. Şarkı, bağırış, gürültü ve seslenme bu genel çekirdeğin özel veya yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, dinleyenin kulağına ulaşan ve canlı ya da cansız çeşitli kaynaklardan çıkabilen işitilebilir sestir.
Bir kaynak, sesi iki cismin çarpışmasıyla sıkışan hava üzerinden fiziksel olarak açıklar; bu açıklama genel işitilebilir ses çekirdeğinin bir çözümlemesidir.
Bir şarkı veya ezgi türü, genel ses kavramının müzik alanındaki özel bir gerçekleşmesi olarak adlandırılabilir.
Bağırma, yüksek ses çıkarma, gürültü ve yardım çağrısı, ses çekirdeğine dayanan olay ve kullanım türleridir.
Bir kişiye yüksek sesle çağrıda bulunma anlamı, yalnızca ilgili söz öbeğine bağlı bir seslenme kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çekirdeği kulağa ulaşan genel ses olarak sunar ve bunu insanlarla sınırlamaz. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca şarkı sesini, bağırmayı, yüksek sesliliği, gürültüyü, yardım çağrısını ve seslenmeyi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlar olarak gösterir; fiziksel oluşuma ilişkin açıklama ise çekirdeğin kaynak düzeyindeki bir çözümlemesidir.

branches.what_is_ar: الصوت الذي يقع في الأذن وما يتصل به من الصياح وشدة الصوت والغناء والجلبة والاستغاثة
branches.what_is_not_ar: الصيت بمعنى الذكر الحسن؛ الإنصات بمعنى الاستماع أو الإجابة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصوت وهو جنس لكل ما وقر في أذن السامع (maqayis)؛ كل ضرب من الأغنيات صوت من الأصوات (ayn)؛ الصوت معروف وهو اسم يلزم كل ناطق من الناس والبهائم والطير وغيرهم (jamhara)؛ الضوضاء والجلبة والاستغاثة (sihah)؛ الصوت هو الهواء المنضغط عن قرع جسمين (mufradat)؛ رجل صيت شديد الصوت وصائت إذا صاح (maqayis)؛ صات يصوت صوتا فهو صائت بمعنى صائح (ayn)؛ الصائت الصائح وقد صات الشيء يصوت صوتا وكذلك صوت تصويتا (sihah)؛ رجل صيت شديد الصوت وصائت صائح (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın iyi ün odağı, kaynak ifadesinde insanlar arasında yayılan güzel ve olumlu anılmayla açıkça desteklenir. Kötü ün özellikle dışarıda bırakılır; sesin yayılması ise güncel çekirdek değil, bu olumlu toplumsal anlamın kaynak düzeyindeki dayanağıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kavram, yalnızca olumlu ve güzel anılmayı kapsar; nötr tanınmışlık, kötü şöhret ve gerçek işitilebilir ses bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim insanlar arasında yayılan iyi ünü karşılar; bir kişinin sesinin yayılması biçimindeki söz öbeği ise yalnızca iyi adının yayılması anlamındaki tanıklanmış mecazla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin insanlar arasında yayılan olumlu ve güzel anılması, yani iyi ünüdür. Nötr tanınmışlık veya kötü şöhret değil, açıkça olumlu toplumsal hatırlanma söz konusudur.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, bir kişi hakkında insanlar arasında yayılan olumlu, güzel ve iyi anılmadır.
Anlamın sesin yayılması düşüncesinden geliştiği belirtilir, ancak yerleşik kullanım yalnızca olumlu ünle sınırlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kavramı insanlar arasında yayılan iyi ve güzel anılma olarak ortaklaştırır ve kötü anılmayı kapsam dışında tutar. Toplu ifade, bu olumlu ün anlamını sesin yayılması düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirirken gerçek sesi güncel anlamın çekirdeği yapmaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi hakkında insanlar arasında yayılmış olumlu ve güzel anılmayı kısa ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu değerlendirme ile insanlar arasında yayılmış olma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin çevresinde olumlu biçimde tanındığını ve hakkında iyi söz yayıldığını açıklayan bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin insanlar arasında olumlu ve güzel biçimde anılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin olumlu ününün insanlar arasında yayılma sürecinin özellikle belirtildiği söz öbeği bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu adın topluluk içinde yayılmasını ve yerleşmesini korur.
İnsanlar arasında yaygın biçimde tanınmayı korur.
error_profile.adds: Olumlu, nötr veya kötü olabilen daha geniş bir tanınmışlık alanı ekler.
error_profile.collision: Kavramın yalnızca iyi anılmayla sınırlı olumlu değerini belirsizleştirir.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu toplumsal değerlendirme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İyi adın insanlar arasında yayılması ve anılma yönünü zayıflatır.
error_profile.adds: Saygınlık, güvenilirlik veya toplumsal konum anlamlarını ekleyebilir.
error_profile.collision: Yayılmış olumlu anılmayı toplumsal değer ve konumla karıştırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca insanlar arasında yayılmış olumlu ve güzel anılmayı gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal şeref, yücelik, övgü ve toplumsal değer gibi iyi ünü aşan unsurları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişinin toplum içinde olumlu biçimde anılması ve değerlendirilmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İyi anılma bağlamında yakınlaşırlar; ancak komşu dal övgü, şeref ve yüksek konumu da içerdiğinden odak dalın daha dar olumlu ün sınırını aşar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, tanınmışlığın olumlu ve güzel anılma niteliği taşımasını zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir topluluğun ulaştığı tanınmışlığı değer bakımından olumlu olmakla sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanlar arasında yayılmış tanınma ve ün durumunu ifade edebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal nötr tanınmışlığa kadar genişleyebilir; odak dalda ise olumlu değerlendirme kurucu ve vazgeçilmez bir koşuldur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal olumlu niteliği sabit olan iyi ün ve güzel anılmayla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yayılan söz, nötr ün, gösteriş ve kötüleyici tanıtma gibi olumlu olmayan kullanımlara da uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişi veya konu hakkındaki sözün insanlar arasında yayılması alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yayılmayı mutlaka olumlu anılmayla birleştirir; komşu dal ise yayım ve duyurma olgusunu değer yönünden çok daha geniş tutar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın sesle bağlantılı dinleme odağı ancak nitelikli biçimde kabul edilebilir. Kanıt, bazı kaynaklarda çağrılan kişinin cevap verip çağırana yönelmesi, Mufradat'ta ise konuşmayı bırakıp dinlemesi biçiminde iki ayrı okuma verir; Mufradat ayrıca cevap verme yorumunu açıkça reddeder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tek ve serbestçe genellenebilen bir karşılık gibi okunmamalıdır; kullanım ya çağrıya cevap verip yönelme okumasıyla ya da konuşmayı bırakıp dinleme okumasıyla sınırlı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kaynaklarda iki bağdaşmayan okuma vardır: çağrıyı yanıtlayıp çağırana yönelme ve konuşmayı bırakarak dinleme. Karşılık verme okumasının açıkça reddedilmesi, bunların tek bir olağan tanım altında birleştirilmesini engeller.

facets.statement: Bir okuma, çağrılan kişinin çağrıya karşılık vermesini ve çağırana doğru yönelmesini sesle tetiklenen bir tepki olarak sunar.
Diğer okuma, kişinin konuşmayı bırakıp kendisine yöneltilen sözü dinlemesini temel anlam sayar.
Kaynak içindeki açık değerlendirme, çağrıya karşılık verme yorumunun geçerli olmadığını bildirerek iki okuma arasındaki uyuşmazlığı kesinleştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Maqayis ve Sihah, çağrı üzerine cevap verip çağırana yönelmeyi sesle tetiklenen bir tepki olarak açıklar. Mufradat ise anlamı konuşmayı bırakıp dinleme diye tanımlar ve cevap verme yorumunu geçerli saymaz; bu yüzden dal tek bir birleşik anlam olarak değil, kaynaklar arası sınırlı bir ayrılık olarak tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın güvenli kısa karşılığı olarak yalnız bu tartışmalı iki kaynak okumasını gösterir; bunları tek ve normalde birbirinin yerine geçebilen bir anlam gibi birleştirmez.

error_profile.preserves: Çağrıya cevap verip yönelme ile konuşmayı bırakıp dinleme okuması arasındaki kaynak ayrılığını korur.
error_profile.loses: Her iki okumanın kaynak içi tartışma ayrıntılarını kısa karşılığa bütünüyle taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Konuşmayı bırakıp söyleneni dinleme okumasını izleyen bağlamlarda kullanılabilir; dalın öteki kaynak okumasını temsil etmez.

error_profile.preserves: Konuşmayı bırakma ve dikkatini söylenene verme bileşenlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Çağrıya karşılık verme ve çağırana yönelme biçimindeki rakip kaynak okumasını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca çağrılan kişinin cevap vererek çağırana yöneldiği kaynak okumasını aktaran bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Çağrıya cevap verme ve çağırana doğru yönelme bileşenlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Konuşmayı bırakıp dinleme okumasını ve cevap verme yorumuna yöneltilen açık itirazı dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ana çizgide sınırı aşma, doğru olduğu bilinen şeyi geri çevirme ve ona karşı koymayı birlikte verir. Bununla birlikte birine karşı aynı işi yaparak boy ölçüşme ve devenin yuları tutana üstün gelmesi de tanıklanır; bu kullanımların tümünü yalnızca doğruyu reddetme diye açıklamak kapsamı gereksiz yere daraltır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana anlam bilinçli karşı koyma ve ölçüyü aşmadır; yarışma ve yulara üstün gelme bunun özel, doğruyu reddetmeye bağlı olmayan gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bağımsız biçimlerdeki azma ve bile bile karşı çıkma çekirdeğini, kişiyle boy ölçüşme ve yulara karşı koyma gibi belirli kuruluşlara bağlı kullanımlardan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir sınırı aşarak doğru olduğu bilinen şeyi kabul etmemek ve ona karşı direnmek; belirli kuruluşlarda bir rakibe karşı durup onunla boy ölçüşmeye ya da yönetenin denetimini zorla kırmaya uzanır.

facets.statement: Kişi ölçüyü aşar, doğruyu bildiği halde onu kabul etmez ve karşı koyar.
Birine karşı durup onunla boy ölçüşmek, kimi durumda onun yaptığının benzerini yaparak yarışmak anlamına gelir.
Deve, yulara yüklenip onu tutan kişiye üstün gelerek onu çekebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birleşen anlatımı, ölçüyü aşma ile bilinen doğruyu reddeden bilinçli direnişi merkeze alır; karşılıklı boy ölçüşme ve denetimi zorla kırma bu çekirdeğin daha özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
